tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ra we/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi spyi bor pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs nas// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// rgyal ba kun dngos khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// gsang ba'i bdag po ye shes mkha' 'gro ma// mya ngan med dpal don yod rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rin chen grags dang brtse chen snying po'i zhabs// rje btsun grags pa chos kyi seng ge dang*// shes rab 'od zer rnam rgyal rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so= /shes rab seng ge gzhon nu tshul khrims zhabs// tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims dang*// ye shes rgyal mtshan kun dga' bzang po la// gsol ba= /kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel// lha mchog seng ge bud+dha siṃ ha dang*// ( yang na tshar lugs ltar na/ nam mkha' dpal bzang grags pa blo gros la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// sngags 'chang kun bsod kun dga' bkra shis zhabs// bsod nams rin chen yab rje kun blo'i mtshan// rnam 'dren mtshungs med kun mkhyen gzim 'og rje// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag phyogs las rnam rgyal dang*// 'dren mchog zung gi rjes bzung gu ṇa'i mtshan// rdo rje 'chang dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ 'di man tshig rkang drug mkhyen brtses so// gang la sgo gsum rab dad mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// 'jam mgon thugs rje'i zla gzhon kun dga'i mtshan// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/) / brang ti pa dang nam mkha' sangs rgyas la// gsol ba=

/nam mkha' dpal bzang sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs// bstan 'dzin lhun grub dpal ldan chos skyong rje// rin chen mchog grub nam mkha' 'chi med la// gsol ba= /kun dga' bstan 'dzin mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang*// blo gter dbang po chos kyi nyi ma'i zhabs// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag gzhan phan snying po la// gsol ba= /rdo rje 'chang dngos bstan 'dzin snying po sogs// rim bzhin brgyud dang dngos su gdams pa yis// bdag blo tshim mdzad bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// gsol ba= /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la gsol 'debs kyis// mkhyen brtse nus pa chen po'i legs gzigs nas// mtha' yas 'gro ba kun gyi don bsgrub phyir// bdag gi smon lam 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// sngon 'gro'i chos kyis bdag rgyud legs sbyangs nas// srung 'khor dbus su pad zlar hūm̐ yig gi /'phro 'du las grub gsang ba'i bdag po yi// rnal 'byor bsgom la gegs med mthar phyin shog /sku mchog bsgoms pas phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas// bsam gyis mi khyab sku yi gsang ba mchog /bdag gis thob nas 'khor ba'i mthar thug par// sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don byed shog /gsung mchog bzlas pas don chen 'grub pa'i rgyu// bsam gyis mi khyab gsung gi gsang ba mchog /bdag gis thos nas mkha' mnyam sems can la// rang rang skad kyis dam chos ston par shog /thugs mchog bsgoms pas srid zhi'i mtha' spangs pa// bsam gyis mi khyab thugs kyi gsang ba mchog /bdag gis thob nas 'gro ba ma lus pa// sems rgyud ye shes mchog tu bsgyur bar shog /de lta'i gsang gsum bsgom pa'i gnas skabs su// nyam thag gzhan gyi nad gdon bar chad rnams// bdag gis mthong thos reg pas kun zhi nas// gnod bya gnod byed bde la sbyor bar shog /mdor na bdag gi las nyon dri ma'i tshogs// thams cad dag nas gsang ba'i bdag po'i zhal// mngon sum mthong nas lus rten 'di nyid la// zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog

/ces don dran bzhin pas gsol ba gdab par bya'o// de ltar gsol ba gdab pa'i yul bla ma 'di rnams ni/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa thun mong ma yin pa'o// thun mong ba ni sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i brgyud pa ltar yin no// zhes pa 'di ni yi dam 'di la mos shing sgrub pa la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pa shes rab dpal ldan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal ldan don grub kyis e waṃ chos 'khor rtser sbyar ba'o// ༈ /na mo gu ru rat+na war+dhā ya/ 'byung po 'dul byed bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan= /dam pa'i chos= /'phags pa'i dge 'dun= /bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes ci nus brjod/ sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du khro bo'i rgyal po dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba la khams gsum ma lus pa gsal bar nus pa'i 'od zer yang dag par 'khrigs pa'i ram̐ yig dmar po/ de las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can 'phros pas khro bo'i dbang po 'byung po 'dul byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ bhū ṭa ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ ces pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces pas tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ ces brjod de/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las dri ma med pa'i hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rdo rje'i pho brang ches shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hrīḥyig las byung ba'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ a yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dngas shing gsal ba'i steng du/ hūm̐yig mthing nag yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje sngon po rwa gdengs pa phyar thabs su 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar 'byung po 'dul byed kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ thod pa skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang*/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis 'byung po gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po mig gsum pa lag pa bzhi pa/ g.yas ḍā ma ru dang gri gug g.yon thod pa dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyis smad dkris shing skra ser po thor tshugs can kha sbub tu mnan pa/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ ham̐'u las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo'i dbang po dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃbadz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ ces pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ne wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ ces pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shre ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ ming med gnyis po bcings byas te// mdzub mo gnyis po bskum par bya// mthe'u chung gung mo de bzhin du// mtheb chen gyis ni gnan par bya// zhes pa ltar gyi rtsa ba'i phyag rgya snying mgrin dpral spyi bzhir reg cing*/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa/ ces brjod pas byin gyis brlabs te sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems yun ring du gtad la/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po mthar sngags kyi phreng bas yongs su bskor ba las rab tu 'bar ba'i sngags kyi 'od zer me'i phreng ba lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad la khyab cing snang bar byas pas nad rims gdon bgegs byad kha rbod gtong mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas rang 'dra ba'i khro chung dpag tu med pa 'phros pas gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bcom ldan 'das kyi sku dang 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam zhing khro bo bzlas pas/

hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra bhū ta a dhi pa ti/ ak+sho bh+ya ki rī ṭi na/ sarba bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsā ni swa dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas/ man ngag shes na rdo rje'i bzlas pa ci nus bya/ thun 'jog pa na/ thal mo sbyar te/ dpal phyag na rdo rjes bdag dang sems can thams cad la steng gdon gza' dang drang srong gi gnod pa/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa/ bar gdon 'byung po rgyal btsan gyi gnod pa la sogs pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing mi 'byung ba dang*/ myur du khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i dngos grub zhus la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas pad zla 'byung po dang bcas pa/ gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim par gyur par bsams la/ ra nga nyid kyang sku'i stod smad nas 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim/ de hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu khog pa la thim/ khog pa mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo zla tshes la thim/ zla tshes thig le la thim/ thig le nā dā la thim/ nā dā'ang mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du gyur/ de las ldang ba na/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ gsal btab ste/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /phyag na rdo rje 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs kyis bsngo ba dang smon lam btab la/ rang nyid gnas skabs thams cad du rdo rje'i pho brang shin tu yangs pa'i nang du lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bsam mo// bsnyen pa byed na zla ba gcig tu thun gsum gyi sbyor bas sngags thung 'bum phrag bcu dang*/ sngags ring khri phrag bcu bzla'o// zhes pa 'di ni dam pa thams cad 'dren pa'i 'jig rten gsum gyi rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gzhung che chung gi snying po bsdus nas nyams su blangs bde bar btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis sbyar ba'o// bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs// gdul dka' 'dul byed dpa' bo che// shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis// ma rung pa rnams tshar gcod shog

/de las byung ba'i dge ba yi// rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba'i mthus// bdud kyi dkyil 'khor kun bcom nas// bde ba che la rol par shog/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
